subject: Mutual action plan: ISV SDK version runway & emergency rollback protocol
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya@matrixlogic.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@matrixlogic.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SDK deprecation timeline request and proposed mitigations

Grace — thanks again for taking time this morning. MatrixLogic is preparing to move customers from ML-SDK v1.1 to v1.3 over the next two quarters. A few ask items after our internal review: 

1) We need a concrete deprecation runway for any Redwood runtime SDK changes that will break the current v1.1 integration (notably tokenization helpers and the streaming socket handshake).
2) If Redwood will remove the legacy runtime endpoints, we need an emergency rollback protocol and a documented fallback variant we can pin to in case of customer impact.
3) Requesting a short risk register and a mutual action plan (MAP) that maps Redwood deliverables to MatrixLogic engineering tasks and dates.

I attached a draft risk spreadsheet and a one-page MAP that our GTM and engineering leads can use. Can Redwood commit to compatibility blackouts being communicated at least 60 days in advance for breaking changes?

Happy to sync Wed if helpful — Priya

--
Priya Sharma
Head of Partnerships | MatrixLogic
priya@matrixlogic.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@matrixlogic.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDK deprecation timeline request and proposed mitigations

Priya — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments, very helpful. High level response and proposed next steps from Redwood: 

Summary:
- We agree that any public-breaking SDK/runtime change should have a minimum 60-day notice; for deprecated endpoints that affect streaming or tokenization behavior, we aim for 90 days when possible.
- We can provide a pinned fallback model variant for up to 180 days post-deprecation if a partner needs an extended runway (requires joint billing/usage caps).
- We will draft a MAP that maps our release milestones to partner migration checkpoints — see proposed MAP v0.1 attached.

Immediate ask from Redwood to MatrixLogic:
- Please review the attached MAP and the risk spreadsheet and mark the top 3 customer-impacting items.
- Identify whether you require an SDK shim (we can provide a short-term client-side shim) or a server-side compatibility layer; shims are delivered as a scoped package and supported for 90 days.

I'll loop in Jonas for release engineering details. Can we do a 30-minute cadence on Wed 5/5 to lock timing?

Thanks — Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (408) 555-0199

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@matrixlogic.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDK deprecation timeline request and proposed mitigations

Priya / Grace — technical note from release engineering: 

- The streaming socket handshake change is currently scheduled for Redwood runtime release 2027.08. We expect the backward-incompatible handshake to be active in the default endpoint on 2027-08-15.
- To support partners we can: (A) keep a legacy endpoint active until 2027-12-15; or (B) provide a compatibility proxy that translates the old handshake to the new one for up to 6 months. Option B requires a small infra charge and a capacity commitment.
- Tokenization helper changes are non-breaking for most callers if they upgrade client-side; we will publish a compatibility shim library (pip/npm) that preserves the old helper API.

Risks we see: customer apps that relied on hand-rolled reconnection semantics may observe higher-rate reconnection storms when legacy endpoints are retired. This is captured in the attached 'ML_SDK_Deprecation_Risks.xlsx'.

If MatrixLogic elects the compatibility proxy, we'll need a signed MAP and a capacity commit (monthly RU commit number) to provision dedicated proxy pools.

— Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Sr. Manager, Partner Engineering | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Priya Sharma <priya@matrixlogic.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@matrixlogic.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDK deprecation timeline request and proposed mitigations

Thanks Marcus — quick replies inline: 

- Legacy endpoint until 2027-12-15 is acceptable for our largest customers if Redwood can commit to 99.9% availability on that endpoint and provide monitoring hooks.
- We are open to the compatibility proxy but need the pricing and RU commitment details; can Redwood provide a ballpark for the proxy infra charge?
- We'll mark the top three customer-impacting items in the spreadsheet by COB Friday and flag any enterprise customers that will need a longer runway.

Can we confirm a 30-minute sync today at 3pm PT to align MAP edits? We will share our migration playbook snippets in advance.

— Priya

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@matrixlogic.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDK deprecation timeline request and proposed mitigations

Priya — follow-up from today's MAP sync and next steps: 

Action items (Redwood):
- Finalize MAP v1.0 and circulate to MatrixLogic by 2027-05-10. (owner: Grace)
- Publish compatibility shim packages (pip/npm) and a migration guide by 2027-06-01. (owner: Jonas)
- Provide legacy endpoint SLOs and monitoring hooks; commit 99.9% availability for the legacy endpoint through 2027-12-15. (owner: Marcus)
- Pricing estimate for compatibility proxy: $7k/month baseline + $0.12/RU over committed RU (subject to contract). Formal quote to follow. (owner: Vanessa)

Action items (MatrixLogic):
- Return top-3 customer-impacting items and list of enterprise customers needing extended runway (deadline: 2027-05-14).
- Confirm whether you want the proxy or the legacy endpoint beyond 2027-08-15 by 2027-05-21.

Attached: MAP_MatrixLogic_v1.1-1.3.pdf (final draft), ML_SDK_Deprecation_Risks.xlsx (risk register).

If MatrixLogic signs the MAP, Redwood will include a clause for emergency rollback procedures and daily syncs during the 30 days after switchover.

Thanks all — Vanessa

--
